stories.title: Entre les Etats-Unis et la Chine, une intense bataille sur l’IA qui nous concerne tous

en.title: Between the United States and China, an intense battle over AI that concerns us all
en.summary: The technological rivalry between the United States and China over artificial intelligence has concrete consequences for how people use AI globally. Europe and Switzerland lag significantly behind in this competition.

stories.title: Les infrastructures menacées par le réchauffement des océans polaires

en.title: Infrastructure threatened by warming of polar oceans
en.summary: Polar sea ice is shrinking rapidly, losing an area equivalent to Spain every decade. This threatens human infrastructure through coastal erosion and endangers species that depend on sea ice for survival.

en.title: Latest developments - FIFA's failed investor plans: SFV withdraws support for Infantino
en.summary: FIFA planned to transfer some commercial rights to private investors but withdrew the proposal in early August. The Swiss Football Association has consequently withdrawn its support for FIFA President Infantino.

en.summary: Neuchâtel's reform of the third educational cycle, which replaced traditional grades with branch-based levels for students aged 14-16, is supported but requires improvements in how it is being carried out.
